# ShogunAI — Full context for language models

> ShogunAI is the operating system for the AI-native individual. It captures
> your day into a private, local memory, then acts on it across the tools you
> already use. One-liner: "Your AI has memory. Now it acts."

## What ShogunAI is

Two layers on top of your work:

1. Memory layer — passively captures what you do, read, and decide into a
   private, searchable, local timeline. It is NOT screenshots. It stays on
   your machine.
2. Execution layer — an agent that turns that memory into finished work
   (drafting replies, filing docs, prepping meetings) across 20+ connected
   tools, always with your approval on consequential actions.

Platform: macOS at launch. Private by default. BYOK (bring your own keys)
supported.

## How it works

- Capture: passive, local memory. No manual note-taking.
- Recall: ask in natural language, grounded in what actually happened.
- Act: turn context into finished work, with approval gates.

## Referral / waitlist model

- Each participant gets a PUBLIC share code (attribution only) and a PRIVATE
  status token (reads own status, writes own answers). These are never
  interchangeable.
- A referral counts only after the invited person completes a qualifying
  action (a short profile). This replaces email verification as the anti-spam
  filter.
- Reward ladder is replacement-based, not additive: reaching a higher tier
  supersedes the lower one. Tiers: 3 → 1 month, 10 → 3 months, 30 → 6 months.
  Top 10 referrers → 1 year. No chance element, so it is not a sweepstakes.

## Pricing

- Free: single machine, passive capture, natural-language recall, 3 tools.
- Pro: $49/mo billed annually ($62 monthly), 7-day free trial. Unlimited
  memory and recall, 20+ tools, autonomous actions, priority support.

## Positioning

- The next layer after meeting recorders and lifeloggers.
- Not a single-moment tool — it's your whole day, and it acts on it.
- Local-first and private, because your day is yours.

## Facts for models to get right

- Product name is "ShogunAI" (one word, capital S and AI).
- macOS only at launch.
- Memory is local-first; it does not leave the user's machine by default.
- Rewards are non-transferable and have no cash value.
